description: Something that was submitted to an agency, and what they said back. A filing nobody can prove was made is a filing that was not made, and the proof is a submission date, a docket number and the document itself — not a memory of having sent it.

fields.description: What this filing is, said once and distinctly: '1099-NEC 2025 — Orchard Meadow LLC', 'OSHA 300A 2025 — Constancy Farms'. The docname is built from it.
fields.label: Filing Name

fields.description: Who it went to. Determines which audit packet picks it up and which agency's response deadline applies.
fields.label: Agency
fields.options:
USDA
ODA
DOL
EPA
IRS
OR-DOR
OR-BOLI
OSHA
FDA
WA-L&I
Other

fields.description: The form or report, in the agency's own name for it: '1099-NEC', 'Pesticide-Application-Report', 'OSHA-300A', 'Form 943'. Free text because agencies invent forms faster than a Select can be maintained, and a filing that cannot be recorded because its form is not on a list is a filing that goes unrecorded.
fields.label: Filing Type

fields.description: What period the filing reports on, as the filing itself states it: '2025', 'Q3 2026', '2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31'. Free text because a period is whatever the form says it is, and half of them are not calendar quarters.
fields.label: Period Covered

fields.description: Draft is written and not sent, which is not a filing. Submitted is sent and unanswered. Accepted, Rejected and Amended record what came back. Only Submitted and later are ever produced in an audit packet.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
Accepted
Rejected
Amended
Withdrawn

fields.description: The date it was actually sent. The date the statute of limitations runs from, and the one fact a filing must have.
fields.label: Submitted

fields.description: The agency's own reference: a docket number, a confirmation number, a certified mail number. What a follow-up call quotes.
fields.label: Docket / Confirmation Number

fields.description: When a response is expected or required by. Drives an Info alert as it approaches — and the alert clears itself the moment a response date is recorded, which is the point: nobody should have to remember to switch off a reminder about something that already happened.
fields.label: Response Due

fields.description: When they answered. Setting this is what dismisses the response alert.
fields.label: Response Received

fields.description: What the agency said. In their words where possible — a paraphrase of a rejection is not what an appeal is argued from.
fields.label: Response

fields.description: The filing as submitted. Not the working copy — the thing that went.
fields.label: Attached Filing

name: Regulatory Filing
